metadata.description: Why did we create bucket NFT? Well, a lot of folks are camera shy and struggle with social anxiety, while many girls feel uncomfortable taking photos without makeup. That's where our bucket NFT comes in—to empower everyone to share photos and videos on social media confidently, without worrying about showing their faces and overcoming social anxiety! MenderNFT used to hang out on the ETH mainnet. We led the Bucket People to craft the MenderFinance tool, explored the Cryptovoxels metaverse, produced the Bucket video MenderShow, and even dipped our toes into TikTok with Bucket short videos. And you know what? We're not slowing down. We're diving into the Bitcoin ecosystem now, and a bunch of introverted Bucket community members are starting to wrap their heads around Ordinals and Rune!
